format: Full-Sized Scoop Shop (approximately 750-1,200 sq. ft., leased)

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a Scoop Shop ranges from $280,300 to $631,300 for a Full-Sized Shop, $228,300 to $435,300 for an In-Line Shop and $188,300 to $402,300 for a Kiosk Scoop Shop (not including estimates for real estate purchases should you wish to purchase the property for your Shop).

fee.quote: When you sign a Franchise Agreement for a Scoop Shop you must pay us the initial franchise fee, which is $39,500, except in the circumstances described below. If you are an existing franchisee and you enter into a Franchise Agreement for an additional Scoop Shop, your initial franchise fee will be $19,750.
fee.note: Existing franchisees: $19,750. Non-refundable Preliminary Agreement Deposit ($10,000 new, $5,000 existing) credited to the fee. Satellite Shop fee $8,000. Prorated for terms under 10 years. Manager-to-Franchisee Pathways Program: fee waiver and up to 2 years of royalty waivers. In 2025, initial fees ranged from $0 to $39,500.

royalty.quote: Royalty Varies, but will not exceed 5% of Gross Sales2/ Current: Royalty: 3% 15th day of each month on the Gross Sales for the prior month

adFund.quote: Advertising Obligations Total: Varies but total will not exceed 4% of Gross Sales Current Allocation: Local Advertising and Promotion: 2% Fund contributions: 2% Cooperative Contributions: none
adFund.note: Currently 2% Fund plus 2% local advertising; total advertising obligations capped at 4% of Gross Sales. No cooperatives at present.

otherRecurring.amount: Will vary depending on POS vendor Currently: $100 per month

otherRecurring.amount: Varies, but shall not exceed $3,500 annually Currently: $0 per month

transferFee.amount: $7,000 (reduced to $3,000 if the transfer is to a legal entity you form for the convenience of ownership)

item19.quote: The median reported Gross Sales for the Scoop Shops in Chart 1 was $583,767. The average reported Gross Sales in 2025 for the Scoop Shops in Chart 1 was $664,862.
item19.note: Gross Sales only; does not reflect cost of goods, operating expenses or rent. Unaudited franchisee-reported data. 61 of 126 shops (48%) at or above $600K. Excludes 9 shops opened or closed during the period and 8 closed 1+ months for weather.

special: Ben & Jerry's Products are manufactured by the franchisor's parent (Homemade) and sold to franchisees through distributors; purchases from approved suppliers are about 75% of start-up and 80% of ongoing purchases. Refurbishment of $5,000 - $15,000 may be required no more than once every five years. Separate Special Venue program (17 franchised shops) is not covered.
issues: The Item 7 Full-Sized low total of $280,300 only adds up using the $8,000 Satellite fee (with the $19,750 Scoop Shop fee the line items sum to $292,050); the printed total is kept. Item 20 Table 1 total net change for 2025 printed as +2 although 154 to 157 is +3. Chart 2 counts 15 seasonal shops while Note 4 says 17.
